name: perspective.save
title: Save perspective
summary: Save a list with its selection, grouping and sort as a named perspective in the repository; an existing name replaces that perspective.
details: A perspective stores no view. Saving under an existing name, in any case or Unicode normal form, changes only the lines of what changed and keeps comments on unchanged lines. A `description` the input leaves out stays in the file; an empty `description` removes it. `filter`, `group` and `sort` the input leaves out are removed. A selection with no condition is `where: { all: [] }`.
whileReadOnlyReason: Checks the conditions, sort and grouping of the perspective against the metamodel, which is missing or faulty.

description.description: What the perspective is for, for people. Left out: an existing description stays. Empty: it is removed.

filter.description: Name of a saved filter that the selection also uses; written as the filter's name is saved.

where.description: The conditions of the selection, checked as in a selection; element references are written as UUIDs. No condition: `{ all: [] }`.

group.description: The grouping of the list, checked as element.list checks `group`.

sort.description: The sort of the list, checked against the metamodel.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.
